groups: Brand, legacy inspector alias, hidden F3 default, input/contenteditable shortcut protection
F3 browser DOM updates are bounded to ~4 Hz and stop while hidden; memory is API-gated
Low / Medium / High presets scale shadows, ocean tessellation, particles and rain with a pixel cap
V2 snapshot reserves active workshop/station ingredients once and saves player/raft motion
Actual reload restores reservations, raft velocity/anchor/sail, swimming/debuffs, inventory and selected tool
Destroying a bound workbench cancels synchronously and refunds exactly once
Destroying an active grill refunds both inputs; no output or duplicate cancellation
Rainwater reservation snapshots/cancellation never manufacture or refund fuel
Dismantling protects cores, requires a hammer and reach, and previews cascading support loss
Real X tap cancels; a continuous highlighted hold dismantles once and settles a detached station job
Tool/ghost churn and repeated damage/repair do not grow GPU geometry allocation after warmup
Rendered long-sailing/chunk roundtrip returns to a bounded GPU allocation and nine loaded chunks
Biome landmarks grant their distinct loot once, persist collection IDs, and unlock all three optional research branches
New raft upgrades build through the existing grid/ingredient path; rain collector output is finite and saveable
Windcatcher sailing bonus, armored shark bite, and spear cooldown work in the integrated game
Visibility/focus handlers clear keyboard, mouse, touch, gamepad and charging state; paused time does not advance
A simulated 120-second stall caps catch-up at eight steps; exact-center reef collisions stay finite
Native WEBGL_lose_context loss/restoration pauses, saves, restores graphics, and does not restart another loop
Invalid imports leave storage and live inventory unchanged; valid imports require explicit confirmation
Confirmed import reloads exact inventory and keeps a separate pre-import backup
New-voyage reset cannot be undone by the old page unload autosave
F3 ignores incomplete startup/resume intervals instead of showing a fabricated 10,000 FPS maximum
A real legacy-key V1 reload migrates progress without changing inventory or replaying old quest rewards
A corrupt local save is quarantined instead of silently overwritten by a temporary new voyage
notes: Visibility/focus events and the 120-second stall are deliberately simulated.
GPU allocation checks cover geometry/resource lifecycle, not all possible browser or driver leaks.
Native WebGL context loss/restoration and real save reload/import are exercised.
